cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though CAMS can be inaccurate on its own, the model uses it as a raw ingredient because machine learning can correct its biases. In live tracking, the system has beaten CAMS in 66 of 70 days, achieving a mean skill vs CAMS of 0.461. Backtests show a mean skill vs CAMS of 0.462, proving that combining CAMS with local data yields a much more accurate forecast than CAMS alone.
